arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Test hex edge case from test_hex_looks_like_binary_issue65
r = parse.parse('a {:x} b', 'a 0B b')
print(f'0B -> {r.fixed[0] if r else \"NO MATCH\"}')

r = parse.parse('a {:x} b', 'a 0B1 b')
print(f'0B1 -> {r.fixed[0] if r else \"NO MATCH\"}')

# Test that x still works with 0x prefix
r = parse.parse('a {:x} b', 'a 0xFF b')
print(f'0xFF -> {r.fixed[0] if r else \"NO MATCH\"}')

# Test that x works without prefix
r = parse.parse('a {:x} b', 'a FF b')
print(f'FF -> {r.fixed[0] if r else \"NO MATCH\"}')

# Test binary
r = parse.parse('a {:b} b', 'a 0b101 b')
print(f'0b101 -> {r.fixed[0] if r else \"NO MATCH\"}')

r = parse.parse('a {:b} b', 'a 101 b')
print(f'101 (binary) -> {r.fixed[0] if r else \"NO MATCH\"}')

# Test octal
r = parse.parse('a {:o} b', 'a 0o77 b')
print(f'0o77 -> {r.fixed[0] if r else \"NO MATCH\"}')

r = parse.parse('a {:o} b', 'a 77 b')
print(f'77 (octal) -> {r.fixed[0] if r else \"NO MATCH\"}')
"
